about_the_game:
Let the games begin.

Madman's Dice is the game ran by the mysterious Ichabod out of his manor on the outskirts of a quiet and beleaguered city; find the thirteen Pages from the Book of Life, and you earn a prize. Of course, you're a thrill seeker - one who wants to find the next big game.

What other reason is there but to roll the dice and play?

He promises an experience unlike any other. So why not come and see?

You might find more than some thrills and a prize to be won by the end of the stories.

Key features:

-13 expansive stories to explore and survive, each harnessing different forms of horror and suspense.

-Writing done by a published author, music written by a prolific musician. 

-Secrets, unlockables, and additional stories and areas only found through exploration.

-Variable scare levels and blood content; raise or lower the intensity and frequency of louder scares to your desired levels.

-Multiple endings based on player actions.

-Lighting system by Shora!

Warning: This game contains content and descriptions that some may find disturbing. It also contains horror elements not suitable for minors. Player discretion is demanded. Some of the content that may be found disturbing includes:

-Graphic descriptions

-Harm to animals and children

-Loud noises

-Death in many forms

content_descriptors.notes: This game does contain written depictions of violence and psychological horror elements not suitable for all audiences.
